'''Walking Horse Heads''' are [[Walking Heads]] of [[Assimilated Horse|Assimilated Horses]].

==''Spawning''==
*Spawned with a 50% chance when an Assimilated Horse dies.
*Spawned by [[Worm|Worms]] through Level 3 [[Scent System|Scents]].

==''Behavior''==
Walking Horse Heads are cowardly Melee swarm units.
*Walking Horse Heads' Melee Attack is performed through contact damage.
* Walking Horse Heads can perform small leaps.
*They will seek out [[Medium Incomplete Form|Medium Incomplete Forms]] to merge with in order to evolve back into Assimilated Horses.
*Any Mob within 3 blocks of a Walking Horse Head will be inflicted with [[Call Of The Hive|COTH]]. This does not go through walls.
*Walking Horse Heads are able to traverse faster in liquids by performing small leaps.
=== ''Weaknesses'' ===

* Walking Horse Heads, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.
* Walking Horse Heads will run away during the daytime if no other parasites are present.
